reasoning: On the season so far the Heat are the stronger team; with home court the Heat start about 16 points better, in a game of about 237 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Heat.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Heat win 88 times in 100, by about 17; most games like this end between 211 and 260 total points.

analyst.text: An emotional night: Giannis Antetokounmpo faces Milwaukee for the first time after 13 seasons ('emotions are for movies'), and Miami will play a tribute video for Tyler Herro, Jaime Jaquez Jr., Kel'el Ware and Kasparas Jakucionis, now Bucks. It is also the first Adebayo-Herro meeting since their July confrontation over a leaked message; Adebayo is probable after hip tightness. Milwaukee are 1-13 on a 10-game skid with 'no one really happy', so the angle leans clearly towards Miami, with Herro's motivation the wild card.
